predecessor_programs.JFK Medical Center / New Jersey Neurosci: NOT a neurosurgery predecessor. Its residency was ACGME NEUROLOGY only (8/yr; njneuro.org 2005 PGME pages, jfkmc.org NJNI 'Fellows, Residents and Students' 2014 = neurology residents + fellows, jfkmc.org neuroscience-institute-education/residency 2020 = 'ACGME-accredited Neurology Residency'). No neurosurgery residency URL on jfkmc.org (8,395 Wayback URLs), jfkhealth.org or njneuro.org.
predecessor_programs.Saint Barnabas Medical Center (Livingsto: Closest lineage, not a legal predecessor. SBMC program pages (barnabashealth.org 2012, rwjbh.org 2019) state it was 'affiliated with Hackensack University Medical Center (HUMC)' (HUMC was its second training site). It unified with Rutgers NJMS (program 57) in 2020-21, under PD Ira Goldstein, who is now PD of the new Hackensack program. DB coverage: SBMC 2014-2018 entrants (Shafiq, Cummock, Arzumanov, Zhao, Talbot, Jani) are in program 57 as 2020-21 joiners; Rocco Dabecco's SBMC->program 2 transfer (2018) is in training_history. NOT covered: SBMC residents who entered 2011-2013 (finishing ~2018-2020) and any 2019 SBMC intern; SBMC never published a roster, so its 2011-2020 residents are only partly in the DB, under programs 57 and 2, never under 23.
